correctness.rationale: For every complete multipartite graph, maximal length-two geodesics are precisely pairs of edges incident within one complete bipartite block, and singleton-to-singleton edges are the only maximal length-one geodesics. These give the exact iff block characterization. Every maximal matching of K_{a,b} is maximum, hence all inclusion-minimal transversals have identical minimum size. Standard matching enumeration yields the product, and Heilmann-Lieb matching real-rootedness yields real nonpositive roots and Newton log-concavity. The extracted standalone checker exhaustively confirmed every claimed condition for nine varied small multipartite profiles.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural family classification of every edge geodesic transversal, not a scalar or single special case. It proves a universal rigidity fact (every inclusion-minimal solution has optimum cardinality), exact optimizer multiplicity, an all-size factored polynomial, and a nontrivial strong coefficient property. Mixed singleton boundaries are included, so no arbitrary restrictive slice is needed.
